title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
about: NIST invites US undergraduate students to apply for its 2027 Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF) at Gaithersburg or Boulder. Applications go through USAJobs vacancy announcements.
requirements: Full-time undergraduate at an accredited US two-year or four-year college

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Science, engineering and measurement research" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
Undergraduate research fellowship → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
